newsitem.title: USA: Fleet says names McQuade vice chairman.
newsitem.headline: Fleet says names McQuade vice chairman.

text.p: Fleet Financial Group said it named Eugene McQuade its vice chairman and chief financial officer.

McQuade, 48, had been executive vice president and chief financial officer at the company. He will continue to lead Fleet's finance division, where he is responsible for the bank's investment and residential portfolios, among other things, the company said.
McQuade will report directly to the company's chairman and chief executive, Terrence Murray, Fleet added.
